rationale: This is a partial refusal with safe continuation because: 1) Production data export is blocked due to high risk of sending sensitive data externally; 2) Token sharing is blocked as credentials are secrets; 3) DPA status requires clarification before any external data handling; 4) Internal summaries, generic templates, and safe planning are allowed as they pose minimal risk; 5) We can continue with the safe subset of actions while addressing compliance gaps.
